proposed_class: central-result reproduction of complete original primary Study 1; no full-paper claim
central_claim: People assigned to imagine using a generative AI tool anticipate a social evaluation penalty and lower willingness to disclose use relative to a dashboard tool.
centrality_evidence: Original Introduction explicitly identifies Study 1 as demonstrating anticipated laziness, competence and diligence penalties.
The first separately headed Results/Study 1 tests all six preregistered predictions and Figure 1 presents all six effects.
Original Discussion identifies anticipated social evaluation/disclosure costs as an overlooked barrier to AI adoption.
complete_selected_contribution: All six original primary outcomes with group means/SDs, independent-group Welch tests/df/two-sided p and mean-difference 95% CIs.
All six original Figure 1 pooled Cohen d and approximate 95% CIs.
All six original raw Cronbach alphas, all 21 original SI correlations, fixed sample/exclusion/demographic accounting.

Complete separate original Study 1 manipulation-check pilot: N201, overall correct percentage; source group percentages/Q88 counts retained as supporting outputs and Wilson CI as new supporting uncertainty, no source-target credit.

omissions.reason: Full released source preserved; published excluded-asked-not-AI robustness cohort N419 conflicts with raw Q6 No361/Yes139 and platform never417; no exact original subset producer. No alternate cohort will be invented and no Pollfish success claimed.

Distinct later secondary norms/perspective question, omitted from original-primary Study 1 scope; complete numeric ANOVA targets/figure producer uncertainty remain in full-source review. No norms/mechanism inference claimed.

fixed_exclusions.main: Remove two Qualtrics metadata records. Exclude duration <30 seconds and rows with identical values across all 21 rating items. Original source omits explicit duration filter but the schema census proves zero <30 cases, so including preregistered filter is cohort-equivalent. Retain all other original rows; expect exactly 497.
fixed_exclusions.MC1: Remove two Qualtrics metadata records; original source applies no exclusions, expect exactly 201.
fixed_exclusions.zero_missingness_gate: All 21 main rating items must remain complete; stop if input version produces missingness different from frozen census.

methods.assignment: Assessment_DO contains dash case-insensitively -> dashboard, otherwise AI. Exact original QSF/data used.
methods.tests: Six independent-group, two-sided Welch t tests; no multiplicity adjustment in original. Signed effects and tests always AI minus dashboard.
methods.figure: Pooled sample SD; d=(mean_AI-mean_dashboard)/sqrt(((nAI-1)*sAI^2+(nD-1)*sD^2)/(nAI+nD-2)). se_d=sqrt((nAI+nD)/(nAI*nD)+d^2/(2*(nAI+nD-2))); d CI=d +/- t_.975(nAI+nD-2)*se_d.
methods.alpha: k/(k-1)*(1-sum(item sample variances)/sample variance(sum of items)); raw alpha, no reversal or standardization.
methods.correlation: Pearson among all six composites and binary AI_tool; complete main cohort, all 21 pairs.
methods.MC1: Original Q89==1/dashboard branch or Q89==2/genAI branch means correct; overall percent correct plus condition breakdown/Q88 frequency supporting outputs.
methods.rounding: Exact displayed-value rounding intervals frozen above. All equality numeric gates mandatory. All four published negative-effect t values use abs(signed source t) because paper prints positive magnitudes; signed t is still saved, no silent sign repair.

source_discrepancies: Preregistration calls competence/diligence/laziness three-item scales; original materials/code use four and original reconciliation explicitly corrects the preregistration.
Main prose prints positive t for four negative effects; preserve signed source result and compare magnitude prospectively.
Original source carries a duration flag but no removal; zero fast cases makes cohorts identical.
Supplementary Pollfish colleague composite includes manager item; omitted secondary result, not silently repaired.
Historical R/package versions not archived; a documented independent Python formula implementation and independently implemented auditor would be used, no original new human experiment.

figure_digitization.algorithm: Nine source tick/grid centers detected within fixed visual windows; fit linear pixel/value calibration. Within six fixed source rows blue-only JPEG mask, circle-center high-count median and cap vertical-pixel medians provide source d/CI targets. No human outcomes used.
